description: Returns who to contact at VertoDigital and how: the named growth lead, their email and LinkedIn, the reply-time commitment and the contact-form URL. Use it when a user asks how to reach the team or who to talk to. To send a message on the user's behalf, use vertodigital_send_enquiry instead; for any other page, use vertodigital_get_page. Pick format by what the user needs: "summary" when you only need to pass on a name, email or link, since it comes from a fixed record inside the server and is instant; the default "full" when they want to see the contact form fields or the ways to message the team, since it fetches the live /contact page. If that live fetch fails, the tool returns the summary record instead of an error, with format: "summary" and a note saying so.

format.description: "summary": structured object (name, title, location, email, LinkedIn, response SLA, contact form URL). "full" (default): the /contact page as markdown.

name: vertodigital_get_contact

markdown.description: The /contact page as markdown - present when format is "full"

note.description: Present when "full" was requested but the live /contact page could not be fetched, so the summary record was returned instead
